verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability for recognizing a previously verified person and reusing their passed check across sessions or products instead of re-running verification. Cross-signup session/device linking (docs-15) is a fraud verdict mechanism, and ongoing re-screening (docs-10) is continuous monitoring. Both are adjacent features, not reuse of a prior passed verification.

support.subject: As a developer, a person verified once can be recognized and reused across sessions or products — documented re-verification and reuse of a prior passed check instead of forcing a full re-run
